DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの移動について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about getting home?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 足が疲れて歩くのがつらくなりました。会計は終わっています。迎えの車が来る玄関まで、手助けをお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計終了後に歩行がつらく迎え車の玄関まで支援を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My legs are tired, and walking has become difficult. I've finished paying. Could someone help me get to the entrance where my ride is coming?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for help to the pickup entrance after payment because walking is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 院内用の車椅子を用意し、案内する係を呼べます。ご自身の今の状態も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can prepare a hospital wheelchair and call someone to escort you. Please also tell us your current condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 立ったり座ったりはできますが、長い廊下を歩くのがつらいです。診察は済んだので、帰る時の移動を相談しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 立座は可能だが長廊下歩行がつらく診察ではなく帰路移動を相談すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can stand and sit, but walking down the long hallway is difficult. My consultation is over; I'm asking about getting out to go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that standing and sitting are possible but the long hallway is difficult, and you're asking about departure assistance rather than a consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。係がこちらへ来ます。お迎えの方は、どの入口へ来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. The staff member will come here. Which entrance will your ride come to?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族が車で迎えに来ます。正面玄関と伝えてありますが、私も図で場所を確認しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族車は正面玄関迎えで本人も図で場所を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My family will collect me by car. I've told them the main entrance, but I'd like to check its location on a diagram too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your family's car will come to the main entrance and you want to check its location on the diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 正面玄関は、この図の下側です。外に雨よけのある乗降場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The main entrance is at the bottom of this diagram. There's a sheltered pickup and drop-off area outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 場所が分かりました。家族へ雨よけの乗降場所と伝え、私は係とそこへ向かう予定を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図の雨よけ乗降場所を理解し家族へ係と向かう予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand the location. I'll tell my family it's the sheltered pickup area and that I'll head there with a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the sheltered pickup location on the diagram and will tell family you'll go there with staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移動の係が来るまで、こちらの椅子でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait on this chair until the escort arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここに座って待ちます。家族への連絡もできたので、係が来たら正面玄関までお願いすると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定椅子で待ち家族連絡済みと移動係へ正面玄関まで頼む予定を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll sit here and wait. I've contacted my family too, so when the staff member comes, I'll ask for help to the main entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll wait on the specified chair, have contacted family, and will request assistance to the main entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、移動の係へ引き継ぎます。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll hand this over to the escort, then. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子さんに声を出してお読みになるなら、児童の場所をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: If you'd like to read aloud to your child, I can show you the children's area.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ここでは静かに読んでいる方もいましたね。子どもには続きを読んであげたいので、移れる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 静かな席の他利用者に気づき子への読み聞かせを続ける場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. There were people reading quietly here, weren't there? I'd like to keep reading to my child, so please show me somewhere we can move.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Notice the quiet readers in Japanese and ask for somewhere to continue reading aloud to your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 奥の児童席をご利用いただけます。今の本も、そのまま持って行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use the children's seats at the back. You can take the current book there as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この本を持って移ります。家へ帰るまで中断するのではなく、そちらで続きから読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本とともに児童席へ移り帰宅まで中断せず続きを読むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll move with this book. Rather than stopping until we go home, I'll continue where we left off there.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll move with the book to children's seating and continue rather than pause until home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 児童席でも、ほかの親子に聞こえすぎない声でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even in the children's area, please keep your voice from carrying too much to other families.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもが聞こえるくらいの声にします。登場人物の声を大きく演じるより、絵を見せながらゆっくり読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子へ届く声量で大声演技より絵を示しゆっくり読みたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll speak loudly enough for my child to hear. Rather than act out characters loudly, I'd like to read slowly while showing the pictures.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll read slowly with pictures at a voice your child can hear instead of loud character acting.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 親子で一緒に座れる席が、今は空いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's currently an empty seat where parent and child can sit together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その席へ行きます。子どもが指さした絵のページを先に見て、飛ばして読んだ部分も一緒に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空いている親子席を選び子が指した絵と飛ばした頁も確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll go there. First we'll look at the picture page my child pointed to and also check the parts I skipped while reading.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the available family seat in Japanese and say you'll check the picture your child indicated and skipped pages.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 読み終えた本の戻し方が分からなければ、児童の担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you're unsure how to return finished books, please ask the children's staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読み終わったら担当へ返す場所を聞きます。続きを借りたいかは、今の一冊を読んだ後で子どもと選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了後に返本場所を聞き次の本は現本後に子と選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: After finishing, I'll ask the staff where to return it. Once we've read this book, I'll choose with my child whether to borrow the next one.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll ask where to return the book afterward and choose the next book with your child after finishing the current one.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、児童席へどうぞ。それでは、親子で読書をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the children's seats, then. Enjoy reading together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の時間は、あと十分ほどあります。次は何を確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have about ten minutes left for your consultation. What would you like to check next?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 質問を五つ用意し、最初の一つは解決しました。次は給与の書類の見方を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五質問の最初一つが解決し次に給与書類の見方を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I prepared five questions, and the first one is resolved. Next I'd like to check how to read my pay document.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that one of five questions is resolved and you next want to understand the pay document.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 給与の書類を拝見します。どの欄が分からないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll look at the pay document. Which field is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右上の日付です。対象は九月とあるのに日付が十月なので、違う月の書類を持って来たのか気になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十月の日付と九月対象月の違いを示し違う月の書類か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The date at the upper right. It says the period is September, but the date is October, so I wondered whether I brought a document for the wrong month.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out October's date and September's covered month in Japanese and ask whether it's the wrong month's document.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右上はこの書類を作った発行日です。対象月の欄は九月と記載されています。二つを分けてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The upper right is the issue date when this document was made. The covered-month field says September. Please view those separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 発行日が十月で、対象は九月ですね。この質問も分かったので、残りの三つは次の相談用にメモへ残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発行十月対象九月と区別し二問解決後の残三質問を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it was issued in October and covers September. That's answered too, so I'll keep the remaining three questions in my notes for the next consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish October's issue date from September's coverage in Japanese and note the three questions remaining after two are resolved.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 副収入の相談では、内容が分かる記録をそろえてください。今、何をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: For advice about side income, please gather records showing its details. What do you have now?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 月ごとの入金記録があります。ただ、細かい内容は家の資料にあるので、次はその資料も持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 月別入金記録はあるが詳細は自宅資料で次回持参すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have monthly deposit records. But the detailed information is in materials at home, so I'll bring those next time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have monthly deposit records but the details are in materials at home that you'll bring next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の相談方法と、持参資料は受付で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Reception can confirm how to arrange the next consultation and what materials to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は発行日と対象月を確認できました。残る三つの質問と詳細資料をそろえ、次の相談方法を受付で聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発行日と対象月を理解し残三質問と詳細資料をそろえ次相談方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I clarified the issue date and covered month. I'll gather the remaining three questions and detailed materials and ask reception how to arrange the next consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the issue date and covered month, will gather three remaining questions and details, and ask about the next consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、今日の欄の確認を担当と続けてください。それでは、次の準備もよろしくお願いします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please continue checking today's fields with the responsible staff, then. Please prepare for the next time too. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 普段は、どのようにお茶を淹れていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-01.translation: How do you usually brew tea?

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつも袋のお茶をカップへ入れています。今日は茶葉を買いたいですが、家に急須がありません。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 茶葉を試したいが急須を持っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I always put a tea bag in a cup. I'd like to buy tea leaves today, but I don't have a teapot at home.
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to try tea leaves but don't own a teapot.

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 茶葉をそのままカップへ入れるより、こちらの茶こしを使う方法をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than putting leaves directly in your cup, would you like to see how to use this strainer?

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見たいです。カップの口は小さめなので、この茶こしが中へ入るか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さいカップに茶こしが入るか見本を見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My cup has a fairly small opening, so I'd like to check whether this strainer fits inside.
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to see whether the sample strainer fits your small cup.

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見本のカップへ載せてご覧ください。持ち手も外へ出る形です。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please try setting it on the sample cup. The handle also sticks out.

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 茶こしの幅を測って控えます。茶葉をたくさん買う前に、家のカップに合う物を用意したいです。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 幅を控え道具適合後に茶葉を増やしたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll measure the strainer's width and note it. Before buying lots of leaves, I'd like to get equipment that fits my cup at home.
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Note the width in Japanese and say you'd like suitable equipment before buying more tea leaves.

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 少量の茶葉もあります。今日はお茶と道具のどちらをお選びになりますか。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have small quantities of leaves too. Will you choose tea or equipment today?

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は少量のお茶だけにします。家のカップの幅を測ってから、茶こしを選びに戻ります。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 少量茶葉のみ購入し自宅採寸後に道具を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll buy just a small amount of tea today. After measuring my cup's width at home, I'll return to choose a strainer.
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Buy only a small amount of tea in Japanese and say you'll choose equipment after measuring at home.

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この茶葉の淹れ方は、袋の案内にもございます。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Brewing instructions for these leaves are also on the bag.

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内もお願いします。急須を持っていないことを先に伝えたので、道具をそろえてから試せそうです。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 淹れ方の案内を受け道具準備後に試すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like the instructions too. Since I explained first that I don't have a teapot, I should be able to try it after getting the equipment ready.
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the brewing instructions in Japanese and say you'll try after preparing equipment.

DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの少量の茶葉と案内をどうぞ。またお待ちしております。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-KYT-UJI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your small amount of leaves and instructions. We look forward to seeing you again. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手が止まっていますね。どの葉を摘むか迷いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've stopped working. Were you unsure which leaves to pick?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の人が速いので追いつこうとして、見本と違う葉もかごへ入れました。数を競うようにしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 速さを競い対象外の葉も摘んだと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The person beside me was fast, so I tried to catch up and put leaves unlike the sample in my basket too. I turned it into a contest of quantities.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Admit in Japanese that you competed on speed and picked leaves outside the intended selection.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は速さを比べる作業ではありません。まず、入れた物を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today isn't about comparing speed. First let's look together at what you put in.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二枚は見本より硬く、色も濃く見えます。今日摘む対象なのか、かごから出して見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 気になる二枚の硬さ色を示して今日の対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two leaves are harder than the sample and look darker too. Could you take them out of the basket and check whether they're among today's intended leaves?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the hardness and color of two questionable leaves in Japanese and ask whether they're today's intended type.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この二枚は今日の対象と違います。次は見本をそばに置いて、一枚ずつ選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Those two aren't today's intended leaves. Next, keep the sample nearby and select one leaf at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。隣の人のかごの量を見るのでなく、自分が選ぶ葉を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の量より見本と自分の葉へ集中する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll look at the leaf I'm choosing rather than the amount in the other person's basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Focus on the sample and your own leaves rather than others' quantities in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今、目の前の葉ではどれを選びますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Which of the leaves in front of you would you choose now?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この見本に近い葉です。迷う葉を先に切ってしまわず、指で示して質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象葉を選び迷う物は摘む前に指で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one that's close to the sample. Rather than cut a doubtful leaf first, I'll point to it and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose an intended leaf in Japanese and say you'll point and ask about doubtful ones before picking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その選び方で続けてみましょう。かごの中を時々見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Try continuing that way. Check your basket's contents from time to time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚を分け、今日の対象の葉だけになりました。速さより選び方を見直せたので、見本を見ながら丁寧に続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象外二枚を分け選び方を修正して丁寧に続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've separated the two leaves, leaving only today's intended ones. I've reconsidered my selection rather than speed, so I'll continue carefully while checking the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you've separated the two unsuitable leaves, corrected your selection, and will continue carefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 落ち着いて進めてください。それでは、また後で様子を見に来ます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed calmly. I'll come back to see how you're doing later. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お茶のお味はいかがでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: How do you like the tea?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 香りは好きですが、思ったより濃くて全部は飲めそうにありません。残すのが失礼か気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 香りは好きだが濃く飲み切れず残す礼儀を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I like the aroma, but it's stronger than I expected, and I don't think I can finish it. I'm worried leaving some might be rude.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you like the aroma but the tea is too strong to finish, and ask about the etiquette of leaving some.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この体験では飲み切る必要はありません。お口に合う分で結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't have to finish it in this experience. Drink only as much as suits you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら無理に飲まず、今の分で終えたいです。嫌だったという言い方ではなく、味の感想も伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無理に飲まず感想を丁寧に伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'd like to stop with what I've had rather than force myself. I'd also like to share my impressions without making it sound like I disliked it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't force yourself to drink and want to convey your impressions politely.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 感じたことをご自身の言葉でお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us what you felt in your own words.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 香りは楽しめましたが、濃い味にはまだ慣れていません。あと一口ではなく、ここまでにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 香りと味の慣れを分け飲用を終えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I enjoyed the aroma, but I'm not used to the strong flavor yet. Rather than another sip, I'll stop here.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish enjoyment of the aroma from familiarity with the flavor in Japanese and say you're finished drinking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。お茶碗は、こちらへ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please put the tea bowl here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらへ茶碗を戻したいです。まだお茶が残っているので、持ち上げる時にどの辺りを持てばよいか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残った茶碗を戻す際の持つ位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to return the bowl here. There's still tea in it, so could you show me where to hold it when lifting it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where to hold the bowl when returning it with tea remaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのまま両手でお持ちになり、台へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hold it in both hands as it is and set it on the stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 置けました。口に広がる香りを楽しめましたし、飲み慣れたお茶との違いも感じました。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 茶碗を戻し香りと普段のお茶との違いを感想として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've set it down. I enjoyed the aroma spreading in my mouth and noticed how it differs from the tea I'm used to. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the bowl in Japanese and share your impressions of the aroma and difference from your usual tea.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご感想をありがとうございます。それでは、残りのご案内もごゆっくりお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your impressions. Enjoy the rest of the guidance at your leisure.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お受け取りの前に、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions before receiving it?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この大きな文字を読めません。帰って家族へどこに来たか話したいので、寺の名前の読みを教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 寺名の読みを家族へ旅の話をするため尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't read these large characters. I'd like to tell my family where I visited when I return, so could you tell me how to read the temple's name?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to read the temple name so you can tell family about your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは光和寺という寺名で、こうわじと読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This temple's name is Kōwaji, read “Kōwaji.”

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こうわじですね。「じ」の所をもう一度お願いします。自分で声に出して覚えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 寺名を復唱し最後の音を再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kōwaji, then. Please say the “ji” part once more. I'd like to say it aloud myself to remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Repeat the temple name in Japanese and reconfirm its final sound.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こうわじです。お寺を指す最後の字を、ここでは「じ」と読んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's Kōwaji. The final character meaning temple is read “ji” here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。旅のノートへ、こうわじとひらがなで書きます。御朱印そのものへ書き足すのはやめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読みを自分のノートへ記し御朱印は書き足さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I'll write Kōwaji in hiragana in my travel notebook. I won't add any writing to the temple seal itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll write the reading in your own notebook and won't add writing to the temple seal.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ノートには、今日こちらへ参拝したことも残せますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also record in your notebook that you worshipped here today.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。いつか来たいという予定ではなく、今日参拝した記録として日付も添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実際の参拝日を記録へ添える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll add the date as a record of today's actual visit, rather than a plan to come someday.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add the actual worship date to your record in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お帳面をお返しします。お名前のお呼び出しに間違いはありませんでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's your seal book back. Was the name we called out correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の帳面です。寺名の読みも覚えたので、家族には自分の言葉で参拝の様子を話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の帳面を確認し学んだ読みで家族へ話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is my book. I've learned the temple name's reading too, so I'll tell my family about the visit in my own words.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your own book in Japanese and say you'll use the learned reading when telling family.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ大切にお持ちください。ご参拝ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take good care of it. Thank you for visiting to worship. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお菓子をご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at these sweets, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この上の小さい葉も食べるのですか。家族に渡すので、飾りかどうか知っておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 菓子上の葉が可食か飾りか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Do we eat the small leaf on top too? I'm giving them to family, so I'd like to know whether it's a decoration.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the leaf on the sweet is edible or decorative.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの葉は飾りとして添えてあります。お召し上がりになる部分ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This leaf is added as a decoration. It isn't a part to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 菓子と一緒に全部口へ入れる物だと思っていました。家族に渡す時も、先に外すと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 非可食と理解し家族へ外すよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was something to put in your mouth together with the whole sweet. I'll tell my family to remove it first too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Recognize in Japanese that it isn't edible and say you'll tell family to remove it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この品をご購入なら、飾りを別にすることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you buy this product, we can separate the decoration too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 祖父に渡す分は、飾りなしで二つお願いします。私の分は一つ、葉を付けたままでよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 祖父用二つは飾りなし本人一つは飾り付きを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two without decoration for my grandfather, please. For me, one with the leaf still attached is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify two undecorated sweets for your grandfather and one decorated sweet for yourself in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つは飾りなし、一つは飾り付きですね。袋も分けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Two without decoration and one with, then. Shall we separate the bags too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 祖父の二つと私の一つを別の袋にしてください。菓子自体を別の商品へ変える必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ菓子のまま飾りの有無で袋を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please put my grandfather's two and my one in separate bags. There's no need to change the sweets themselves to another product.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the same sweets in Japanese but request separate bags by decoration choice.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご用意できました。こちらが飾りのない二つです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: They're ready. These are the two without decoration.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。祖父の袋には食べない飾りが入っていないので、菓子をそのまま渡しやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 祖父用の袋に飾りがないことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked. My grandfather's bag has no inedible decoration, so it's easier to give him the sweets as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that your grandfather's bag contains no decoration.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三つで承りました。それでは、お茶の時間をお楽しみください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your order is three sweets, then. Enjoy your tea time. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらまでお送りしますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で乗りますが、降りる所が違います。先に友人を宿へ送り、その後で私が駅へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の降車先と宿から駅の順序を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two of us, but we're getting out at different places. I'd like to drop my friend at their accommodation first, then go to the station myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request two drop-off destinations in Japanese in the order accommodation then station.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宿の場所は、お分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know where the accommodation is?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この住所です。友人はそこで降ります。駅を最初に言ってしまうと、友人も駅へ行くと思われそうなので順序を伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿住所と友人の降車場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the address. My friend will get out there. If I mentioned the station first, you might think my friend was going there too, so I explained the order.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the accommodation address and your friend's drop-off location in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宿を先に確認します。お二人の荷物はどちらを先に出しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the accommodation first. Which person's luggage should come out first?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人の小さいかばんは手元へ、私の大きいかばんだけ後ろへ入れます。宿では私の大きいかばんは出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人手荷物と自分の荷室荷物を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend's small bag will stay with us, and only my large bag will go in the back. My large bag won't come out at the accommodation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your friend's hand luggage from your own luggage in the rear in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。途中のお支払いについてはどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. What would you like to do about paying along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で割らず、最後に私が払います。友人とは後で分ける約束なので、宿で会計を止める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最終地点で本人一括支払し途中精算不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't split it along the way; I'll pay at the end. My friend and I agreed to settle later, so there's no need to stop for payment at the accommodation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll pay everything at the final destination and no interim payment is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宿でご友人が降りて、駅に到着しました。メーターの料金をご確認ください。後ろのお荷物もお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your friend got out at the accommodation, and we've reached the station. Please check the meter fare. I'll take out your luggage from the back too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅までありがとうございます。表示の料金を支払います。友人の小さいかばんは宿で本人が持って降りたので、自分の大きいかばんだけ受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二地点の降車完了後に料金を支払い本人の荷室荷物だけ受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you for taking me to the station. I'll pay the displayed fare. My friend took their small bag when they got out, so I'll collect only my large one.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After both drop-offs, pay the fare in Japanese and collect only your own luggage from the rear.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お支払いを確認しました。お荷物はこちらです。ご乗車ありがとうございました。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've confirmed payment. Here's your luggage. Thank you for riding with us. Have a safe onward journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどのお荷物について、何か追加でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything else about the parcel from earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ茶を送ったのですが、淹れ方の案内が手元に残っていました。発送した箱には入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送箱に茶の説明を入れ忘れ手元にあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I sent tea to my family, but the brewing instructions are still with me. They're not in the box I sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you forgot the tea instructions in the sent box and still have them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 差出しの控えはお持ちですか。発送後の取扱いは、まず確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the shipping receipt? We need to check how it can be handled after dispatch first.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 控えはあります。ただ、案内一枚のために必ず箱を戻してほしいという希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えを示し必ず取り戻す希望ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the receipt. But I'm not insisting that you retrieve the box just for one instruction sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt in Japanese and explain that you aren't demanding retrieval.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱を取り戻す手続きには条件があります。別の方法で案内を伝えることもできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Retrieving the box has conditions. Can you convey the instructions another way?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族に電話できます。案内を写真にして送り、茶が届いた時に見るよう伝える方法にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話と案内写真で家族へ伝える方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can phone my family. I'll send a photo of the instructions and tell them to look at it when the tea arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese to convey the instructions by phone and a photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、今回のお荷物自体を変更するご依頼はありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then you aren't requesting any change to this parcel itself, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。箱の変更は頼みません。入れたと思い込んでいたことを家族へ訂正し、写真で説明を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物変更依頼を取りやめ同梱した説明を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct. I won't ask for a box change. I'll correct my assumption that I packed the instructions and send my family the explanation as a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Withdraw the parcel-change request in Japanese and correct the claim that the instructions were enclosed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送の控えは、そのまま保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the shipping receipt as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えと案内の原本を持ち帰ります。家族には荷物の中に説明があると言わず、別に送ると知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控え原本を持帰り案内を別送すると知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the receipt and original instructions home. Instead of telling my family the explanation is in the parcel, I'll say I'm sending it separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll take the receipt and original home and tell family the instructions will be sent separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お控えをお忘れなくお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please remember to take your receipt. Thank you.
